part2.transcript: Is Mr. Johnson joining us for lunch? (A) Yes, I'm hungry too. (B) No, he's occupied. (C) I brought a sandwich.

When will the company release its newest video game console?
(A) At midnight tonight.
(B) He will renew his lease next month.
(C) It's on the desk.
How did you get such great seats for the concert? (A) By winning tickets at a raffle. (B) At least once a week. (C) He's a world-renowned musician.
Why are the lights off in the conference room? (A) I was sitting there. (B) They are watching a video. (C) Yes, she's off duty.
Do you know where the employee break room is? (A)We will take a ten-minute break. (B) Have you worked here long? (C) On the second floor.
Who replaced the ink cartridge? (A) Suzy did this morning. (B) In the shopping cart. (C) It's a brand-new printer.
I'm so thankful for all your help in preparing this report. (A) You're welcome to stay. (B) Don't mention it. (C) I need a pair of gloves.
Would you like to make a reservation for tonight? (A) The dinner was delicious. (B) I would, for six people. (C) It's an expensive hobby.
Why did you open the window? (A) To let in some fresh air. (B) In the master bedroom. (C) Because the store will open next month.
Let's stop by the post office on the way. (A) A letter to my cousin. (B) OK, where is it? (C) The delivery arrived yesterday.
There's a name missing from the list of speakers. (A) Oh, who is it? (B) I'll make twenty copies. (C) Yes, he agreed to the contract.
What day are we hosting that party? (A) Yes, it's ready. (B) He requested a chocolate cake. (C) Check the calendar in the office.

You should sign up for a computer programming workshop. (A) Mr. Greene will assign more employees to the project. (B) You don't think it would be too difficult for me? (C) Please refund this purchase.
You've finished interviewing the candidates, haven't you? (A) It was in the meeting room. (B) Yes, the last person just left. (C) Where did you put the applications?
Would you like to be in charge of entertainment or catering? (A) I'll take care of food and drinks. (B) It was a great party. (C) The stage is too small.
Don't we need to check out soon? (A) No, I reserved the room until tomorrow. (B) The hotel doesn't provide room service. (C) Let's make a reservation for 6 o'clock.
I'm excited to start using this new software. (A) Yes, it should make work easier. (B) It's old, but still usable. (C) I was disappointed in him.
Why don't we hand out free samples to customers? (A) No, it's the customer service department. (B) Because we conducted a survey. (C) Yeah, that's a good strategy.
The building site hasn't been selected, has it? (A) We are still considering multiple options. (B) It's a luxury apartment complex. (C) He will cite a passage from his book.
How did you hear about the meeting on Thursday? (A) Mr. Shepard told me at lunch. (B) My neighbor gave it to me. (C) I can't tell them apart.
Should I tell Susan for you, or do you want to tell her yourself? (A) She's a teller. (B) I want to do it directly. (C) I forgot the phone number.
The annual sales report is finished. (A) We should proofread it before printing. (B) I watched the weather report too. (C) They raised the price by 10 dollars.
Is this used vehicle for sale? (A) Yes, and I changed the tires on it. (B) The price of gas is reasonable. (C) I used it for cooking.
What is needed to apply for this job? (A) Yes, she starts on Monday. (B) A bachelor's degree or higher in engineering. (C) The rule doesn't apply to children under 8.
Who's in charge of designing promotional handouts? (A) Mr. Wilson was promoted to sales manager. (B) The man wearing the blue shirt. (C) We don't charge for delivery.
